title: Softing Secure Integration Server URI NULL Pointer Dereference Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Softing Secure Integration Server. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of the URI HTTP header. The issue results from dereferencing a null pointer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
